method: Screenshot-based spec comparison. Design read from Figma node 9364:82537; build supplied as a screenshot. Items marked verify await pixel sampling of the build capture.

deferred.title: Email + captcha + OTP instead of Digilocker / mobile+password multi-method form
deferred.reason: Email-OTP is the approved method. Figma frame to be updated; design samples delivered separately.

deferred.title: Hero uses a flat navy gradient instead of the designed contextual photograph

screens.name: Login
screens.note: Build panels render once captures/live/login.png is saved. 2 findings deferred by decision — SAM-LOGIN-001 (email-OTP is the approved login; Figma to be updated) and SAM-LOGIN-002 (hero photograph, parked).

findings.figma: Contrast toggle followed by a dedicated accessibility (person) icon.
findings.live: Contrast toggle followed by an info (ⓘ) icon.
findings.fix: Use the accessibility-options icon per design, or confirm the info icon is intended.

findings.figma: Two partner logos on the right: Digital India + SAMAVESH.
findings.live: Three logos: गरिमा गृह (Garima Greh) + Digital India + SAMAVESH.
findings.fix: Likely intentional (contextual to the signed-in portal). Confirm; if so, add the Garima Greh logo to the design frame for parity.

findings.figma: The form block (tabs → CTA → fields → button → links) fills the right panel.
findings.live: The shorter email-OTP form is top-aligned, leaving a large empty area below 'Send OTP'.
findings.fix: Vertically centre the form block within the right panel so it reads as balanced.

findings.figma: 'Log in to your account' ≈ 20px Medium, dark navy (Title-1 / Headline-4 token).
findings.live: Heading reads noticeably larger and heavier.
findings.fix: Match the heading to the design token (≈20px Medium). Confirm exact size from the build capture.

findings.figma: Field labels carry no required marker ('Mobile Number', 'Password').
findings.live: Field labels carry a red required asterisk ('Registered email ID *', 'Security Check *').
findings.fix: Pick one convention across the system; add required markers to the design pattern or drop them in the build.

findings.figma: Primary/Source navy #003366 for the primary button and the top utility bar.
findings.live: 'Send OTP' button and the top utility bar appear to use a lighter / more saturated blue.
findings.fix: Confirm both bind to Primary/Source #003366. Demote to Minor (or drop) if the on-screen blue matches once sampled.

findings.live: Inputs appear lighter-bordered and more rounded.
findings.fix: Confirm input border colour, radius and height against the design tokens from the build capture.
